Fingerprint independent review — checkpoint 230

Reviewed exact head 78b4728cc732488a2e1a0e1a0ef8132e36bcc537. The two candidate dispositions are supported within the bounded review; two P3 wording corrections remain open on this committed head:

1. Action 2:89: restore the complete DoD alternative “high priority requirements or operational needs” and its transition/acquisition condition, retaining the surrounding readiness/POM and matching-funds conditions. Exact governed source: S3971ES[13018:13226).
2. Replace active private-draft / “no completion credit” wording with accurate candidate screening status. Preserve the separate lack of ordinary-routine benchmark credit, pending editorial acceptance/publication and historical draft receipts. Suggested meaning: candidate screening is recorded; this does not confer ordinary-routine benchmark credit, editorial acceptance or publication.

The prior sole writer reports both repairs already applied locally in the existing .w/ib worktree, with eight focused checks and conservation passing, but not committed or pushed. Reconcile those local changes rather than duplicate them. Include the repairs in the next coherent batch; do not run a separate broad gate merely to acknowledge this comment. Required repository gates still apply to final changed bytes.

Independent verification on the committed head: seven byte-exact CLI outputs, 31 focused tests, three resealed CLI rejection probes, 106 conservation assertions, and 49 source/history checks. The unchanged checkpoint222 regression passed against its verified immutable fixture; current tests preserve 2:193’s hold and bind 2:89’s new closure. All 72 prior cores, 120 propositions/readables and 144 member observations remain exact. Counts reconcile to 647 reviewed / 29 pending, 73 cores / 122 propositions. Crane 2:27 adds no core; 2:308 remains pending.

CI run38666512946 completed ten first-attempt jobs, with five feature/four synthetic/one mixed checkout contexts, four executed late stages and four skipped historical guards. Synthetic integration is against af6cd6d plus this exact head. The owner’s full 406-test run and private preservation checks remain attributed, not independently reproduced here. No fresh primary acquisition or excluded reads occurred. This is not full-corpus clearance or editorial acceptance.

Retain all denied/cancelled-source restrictions and candidate/publication boundaries. The former writer is stopped for a desktop execution-route handoff; do not create a competing writer. This comment records review evidence and next-work guidance, not a claim that a replacement task has started.
